item.title: Track Your Routine – Open-source app for task management
item.description:
📝 Built with Firebase for authentication and data storage, TYR ensures your tasks are securely synced across all your devices. Firebase Setup Create Firebase Project Go to Firebase Console Create a new project or use an existing one Enable Authentication (Email/Password method) Enable Cloud Firestore database Configure Firebase for Your Platform Android: Download google-services. dart with your Firebase project configuration, or regenerate it using: flutterfire configure 4.
